name: Context Map

predecessor_artifact_type.compatibility: Historical v1 maps retain their exact endpoint contract; v2 clarifies sole membership ownership and adds a generated reverse lookup without rewriting them.

generated_projection_contract.purpose: Provide reverse lookup from exact context versions to the Context Maps that canonically contain them without adding endpoint backreferences.
generated_projection_contract.canonical_inputs: Exact Context Map/v2 map.json records and their SHA-256 digests only.
generated_projection_contract.rebuildability: The projection is sorted, timestamp-free, disposable, and byte-reproducible from the same exact map inputs.

distinct_validation_purpose: Proves sole canonical ownership of exact endpoint membership and typed directional relationships, while producing a deterministic noncanonical reverse-membership projection.

orthogonality_rules.statement: Every relationship has distinct explicit source and target context references contained in the same map's exact endpoint set.
A relationship is never inferred from directories, imports, proximity, shared labels, or endpoint backreferences.
The Context Map solely owns endpoint membership and directional relations.
Reverse membership is a generated noncanonical projection built only from exact map records.

four_facets.classification: Map identity, endpoint membership, relationship kind, direction, owners, authority, and lifecycle remain explicit dimensions owned by the map.
four_facets.schema: The closed v2 schema requires exact context refs and fully bounded directional relationships; endpoint contexts are not part of the map representation.
four_facets.human_continuation: MAP.md is deterministically generated from map.json and exposes endpoints, translations, information and authority boundaries, evidence, residue, and drift route.
four_facets.machine_checkable: Endpoint closure, endpoint-set exactness, non-reflexivity, unique relationship identity, Definition currentness, hostile fixtures, reverse-index determinism, and projection parity are executable.

typed_residue.missing: No artifact-type-owner admission decision binds this v2 candidate.
typed_residue.consequence: No Context Map instance may rely on v2 as an admitted type.

typed_residue.missing: No normalized successor context endpoints or successor Governance-to-Ontology-Lifecycle map are authored.
typed_residue.consequence: The fixture proves mechanics only and cannot become a real relationship decision.

claim_ceiling: This package is a Context Map/v2 artifact-type candidate. PASS proves only its exact schema, dependency, predecessor, fixture, relation-ownership, generated-index, and projection checks; it does not admit the type, create or revise a map, select an integration relationship, authorize migration, or establish a stable release.
